notes: «حدثني أبي» : bare father, a relation link; «عن أخيه علي بن مهزيار»: «أخيه» + a name is the name alone
Harun was present: «سأل رجل أبا عبد الله (ع) وأنا عنده» — the asker is only in the scene, so the Imam is the last link (owner ruling 2: imam_in_text), surface as written
«ره» and «(ع)» are honorifics, not in the surface
